import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB
products = []
profit = {}
resource_req = {}
resource_capacity = None
for rec in LEGACY_RECORDS:
    src = rec['source']
    vals = rec['values']
    if src.endswith('products.csv'):
        item = vals['item_name']
        products.append(item)
        profit[item] = int(vals['item_value'])
        resource_req[item] = int(vals['resource_requirement'])
    elif src.endswith('capacity.csv'):
        resource_capacity = int(vals['resource_capacity'])
if resource_capacity is None:
    raise ValueError('Missing resource capacity in LEGACY_RECORDS')
if set(profit.keys()) != set(products) or set(resource_req.keys()) != set(products):
    raise ValueError('Missing profit or resource requirement for some products')
m = gp.Model('Bakery_Stocking')
x_vars = m.addVars(products, lb=0, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='')
m.setObjective(gp.quicksum((profit[i] * x_vars[i] for i in products)), GRB.MAXIMIZE)
m.addConstr(gp.quicksum((resource_req[i] * x_vars[i] for i in products)) <= resource_capacity, name='storage')
m.Params.MIPGap = 0.0001
m.optimize()
if m.Status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    print(f'ObjVal: {m.ObjVal}')
    for v in x_vars.values():
        print(f'{v.VarName}: {v.X}')
else:
    print(f'Solver status: {m.Status}')
